Iran Holds Funeral for Ayatollah Khamenei Amid International Attention

Iran held funeral ceremonies for its late Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, who was killed on February 28 along with four family members. Thousands of mourners gathered in Tehran, with some calling for revenge and displaying effigies of US President Donald Trump. Several countries reportedly skipped the funeral due to US pressure, while India's participation was acknowledged with gratitude by Iran.
